findings.title: Build artifact staged
findings.detail: web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo (the tsc incremental build cache) is in the staged set. It is volatile and churns on every build. It is NOT a laneB4c source file (not in the handoff files_changed) and may be a prior-batch staging artifact carried along.
findings.recommendation: Add web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo to .gitignore and unstage it; do not commit the tsc build cache.

findings.title: Custom-order create omits a price hint field
findings.detail: CustomOrderPage builds the CreateOrderRequest inline with priceType:'Estimate' and no estimatedPriceCzk, while the route path uses orderForm.ts buildRouteOrderRequest. This is correct for custom orders (the server re-prices), and the backend accepts a null estimate; noted only as a consistency observation, not a defect.
findings.recommendation: Optional: if the server wants the last-seen estimate echoed, thread quote.view into estimatedPriceCzk; otherwise leave as-is.
